visualCharacteristics.purpose: details panel with a title and meta line (event date/time or read time), clamped description with a Read more toggle, and optional presenter headshots

contentPattern.structure: row 1: [title, e.g. Synopsis or Event details] [meta, e.g. date/time or 6 Minute Read]; row 2: description text; optional row: Read more (becomes the expand toggle); optional rows, one per presenter: [headshot image] [name (link) + role]

usage: Synopsis/details panel on insight and event pages (about 12 pages); captured instances show the panel without presenters.
reuseGuidance: Use for synopsis or event detail panels without author bylines; presenters are optional rows. Use article-synopsis when the panel carries article author bylines.
